lines.zh: 我一身绿，走在草里几乎看不见
lines.en: Dressed in green, I nearly vanish in the grass.
I trot with short steps, sword tip low.

lines.zh: 我的靴子很硬，踩草有响
lines.en: My boots are hard and crunch the grass.

lines.zh: 我跟着旗子的方向前进
lines.en: I advance toward the banner.

lines.zh: 我走的时候左右看两次
lines.en: I check both sides twice as I go.

lines.zh: 绿色的染料是我的记号
lines.en: The green dye is my mark.

lines.zh: 我沿着一排树走，借阴影
lines.en: I move along a row of trees, using shade.
I leave small pits in the mud.
I keep my spacing from the others.
I approach with a pause at every step.

lines.zh: 我的手臂比我的人还长一点
lines.en: My arms are a little long for my body.
I go around stones without a sound.
I crouch in the grass, waiting.
A patch of my green has worn off.
I lay the sword across my knees.
I count the enemies ahead.
There is a crack along my helmet's edge.

lines.zh: 风吹草动，我的头就转过去
lines.en: Grass moves, and my head turns.

lines.zh: 我身上有染料和土混的味道
lines.en: I smell of dye mixed with earth.

lines.zh: 这一带的地形我看清了
lines.en: I have the terrain in mind.
I keep still; moving chips the paint.
I kneel on one knee, ready to rise.
I look up and bring the sword across.
Your colors do not match the grass.
My green face shows nothing.
Come closer and I raise the blade.
My owner said: look first, then strike.

lines.zh: 我站起来了，比你矮一个头
lines.en: I stand; I am a head shorter.
Your shadow falls on me.
If you retreat, I will let you go.
I am waiting for your first move.
I carry a smell of dye.
This time I do not plan to step aside.
I back two steps, sword still held.

lines.zh: 这一下在我肋侧开了口
lines.en: That opened a gash in my side.

lines.zh: 我叫不出来，黏土没有声音
lines.en: I cannot cry out; clay makes no sound.
My leg gives and I kneel.
A patch of green paint peels off.
I do not give way; I push forward.

lines.zh: 身上发出细小的碎裂声
lines.en: Something in me cracks softly.

lines.zh: 这一下拖慢了我的步子
lines.en: That dragged my step.
I shift the sword to my left hand.
A crack runs across my knee.
I know green dye when I see it.

lines.zh: 这东西不能吃，我也不吃
lines.en: This is not food, and I do not eat.
I glance once; my hand stays still.

lines.zh: 木棍能让我更强，这个不行
lines.en: A stick would strengthen me; this will not.
Set it down; I still will not take it.
I take only what my owner gives.

lines.zh: 我的手上是黏土，抓不住细东西
lines.en: My hands are clay; they cannot hold fine things.
Dye I would accept.

lines.zh: 这点东西换不了我的剑
lines.en: That cannot buy my sword.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的草屑落了一身
lines.en: You hit me, and grass bits fall off me.
I block with the blade and give two steps.

lines.zh: 我的身体不重，却被撞得歪了
lines.en: I am not heavy, but the hit knocks me crooked.

lines.zh: 这一下碰掉了我一块绿漆
lines.en: That knocked a chip of green off.
I steady and raise the sword again.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音发闷
lines.en: We collide with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 我不退远，草丛就是我的位置
lines.en: I do not go far; the grass is my position.
I brace a foot to hold.
You did not break through me.
Again, and I will still be standing.

lines.zh: 这一批士兵都是一起捏的
lines.en: This batch of soldiers was shaped together.
You and I need no words.
You lead; I cover the rear.

lines.zh: 绿的喜欢跟绿的站一起
lines.en: The green ones like to stand with green.

lines.zh: 同一面旗下，就是一个队伍
lines.en: Under one banner is one squad.
If you fall first, I hold in your place.
We have nothing personal.
A common enemy is enough.
Our paint will wear off together.

lines.zh: 并肩站的时候，间距正合适
lines.en: Standing abreast, our spacing is right.
My fingers are too stiff to pinch.
This is light; I can carry it.
I tuck it at my belt.

lines.zh: 我一只手拿剑，一只手拿它
lines.en: Sword in one hand, this in the other.

lines.zh: 它从我的黏土手上滑了
lines.en: It slides off my clay hand.
I hand it back.

lines.zh: 我不需要这个，绿染料已经染进泥里。
lines.en: I need nothing; green dye is in my clay.
I hold it a moment and set it down.
It fell in the grass; I did not search.
I lift the sword tip.
This one I can handle.
Its back is toward me.
Just one step of distance.
My comrade is on the right and will follow.
I do not shout; it would give me away.

lines.zh: 敌人在移动，我看清了路线
lines.en: The enemy is moving; I see the path.
This opportunity is good.
I cut in from the flank.
My owner's order has not changed.
I take the first step.
This time I strike first.
I follow close through the grass.
It turns, and I freeze.
I wait with the sword raised.
I am not quick, but it cannot run far.
I count its footsteps.
The grass hides half of me.
It went behind the stone.
I shift my angle.
This blade goes for the joint.
I can see it is tired.

lines.zh: 同伴已经从另一边绕过去
lines.en: My comrade has already gone the other way.
Two steps closer.
It has backed to the water.
Poor footing at the water; I wait.
I cut down on a slant.
The blade lands on its leg.
I leap to reach higher.

lines.zh: 它的护甲挡住了，我换成戳
lines.en: Its armor stops me; I switch to a thrust.
I step back and raise the blade again.

lines.zh: 这一下带着我的整个身子
lines.en: That carried my whole body.

lines.zh: 我被打得转了一圈，还是举着剑
lines.en: Knocked into a spin, sword still up.

lines.zh: 我砍中两次，第二次更重
lines.en: Two hits; the second was heavier.
My hands are numb from the shock.

lines.zh: 这一剑没砍到，草被削了
lines.en: That missed; the grass took it.
I slip behind for one more.
I retreat the moment it lands.
Blood has covered my green paint.
Again; I have not broken yet.
This hand can still lift the sword.
Something green stands up in the grass.

lines.zh: 我是用绿染料染过的黏土
lines.en: I am clay stained with green dye.

lines.zh: 我从被放下的位置立起来
lines.en: I rise from where I was placed.

lines.zh: 我的手先握紧，然后才睁眼
lines.en: My hand closes before my eyes open.
A row of comrades stands beside me.
My paint is still new.
I make no sound in the shadows.

lines.zh: 我的剑是从一开始就有的
lines.en: The sword was mine from the start.
The moment I land, I look for the banner.
The wind parts the grass and reveals me.
My green stands out against the dirt.
I set myself and wait for the first order.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的绿漆全起了泡
lines.en: Fire blisters all my green paint.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摔在草丛里
lines.en: I fall from height into the grass.

lines.zh: 水渗进来，我的胳膊变软了
lines.en: Water seeps in and my arm goes soft.
The blast throws me into the rocks.
That force flattens me into the grass.
I do not eat; I have no need.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的绿一瞬间变白
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my green goes white.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我碎成一把土
lines.en: The ground vanishes; I crumble into a handful of earth.
